title: Hooks: adapter compile cache + hookEnabledLite + write-guard allow-only fast path for Read/Glob/Grep
action: Per exec-speed D3. (a) adapter.mjs: at module top (after existing imports), guarded enableCompileCache(path to os tmpdir bee-compile-cache) in try/catch — benefits every wrapper's LATER dynamic imports (state.mjs 195KB, guards.mjs 101KB, cells.mjs 179KB). (b) adapter.mjs: export hookEnabledLite(root, name): reads <root>/.bee/config.json and <root>/.bee/config.local.json (overlay wins where present, matching state.mjs readConfig precedence for hooks.*), returns config.hooks[name] !== false; ANY read/parse error returns true (fail-open = enabled, matching hookEnabled semantics for a missing config). Never throws. (c) bee-tools-logger.mjs: replace the state.mjs dynamic import + hookEnabled call with hookEnabledLite; drop the fs.existsSync state.mjs check (no longer needed); everything else byte-identical. (d) bee-write-guard.mjs: add an ALLOW-ONLY fast path immediately after readHookContext and the hookEnabledLite gate, for tool_name Read|Glob|Grep ONLY: extract the static read-policy constants (secret-shaped filename patterns, scout-dir list, read-size threshold) from guards.mjs into a NEW tiny module .bee/bin/lib/guard-lite.mjs; guards.mjs imports those constants from guard-lite.mjs (single source, byte-identical policy — extend the existing lib-mirror expectations only if a checker complains). Fast-path logic: resolve the tool's target path(s); if NONE matches a secret pattern, NONE is under a scout dir, and (for Read) the stat size is under the threshold, exit 0 silently WITHOUT importing state.mjs/guards.mjs. ANY match, any stat/parse doubt, any non-string path => fall through to the existing full guard path unchanged, so every deny message stays byte-identical. Glob/Grep pattern-only invocations with no resolvable path => fall through (never guess-allow a suspicious shape). Keep the whole fast path inside the existing fail-open try/catch discipline. Measure: pipe a Grep payload and a Read payload through the hook before/after and report ms in your result.
